name: Weberhof
beschreibung: The Weberhof is located at the entrance to Brixen im Thale, right by the approach to the Brixental valley. The property radiates traditional charm with abundant natural woodwork inside, paired with simple and functional furnishings. Guests can enjoy authentic Tyrolean cuisine made with local produce, as well as a cosy parlour where locals and visitors come together. Parking spaces are located directly at the house.
